description: Defines a generic class PagedList that encapsulates a subset of data items with pagination details, including start/end indices, total size, view index/size, and the data list itself. Implements Iterable to allow iteration over the data items.

classes.name: PagedList
classes.description: A generic class representing a paginated subset of data with pagination metadata, implementing Iterable for data traversal.

methods.name: PagedList
methods.description: Constructor initializing all pagination fields and data list.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Static method returning an empty PagedList with specified view index and size.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the start index of the paged data.

methods.name: getEndIndex
methods.description: Returns the end index of the paged data.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the full data set.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data items in the current page.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Returns the view index provided by the client.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the view size provided by the client.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the data list.
